pages.text: Crops $(bold)do not grow out of season$(). Hover over seeds: the tooltip lists fertile seasons.$(br2)$(bold)Spring:$() carrots, potatoes, cabbage, onions, berries, most saplings$(br)$(bold)Summer:$() wheat, melons, tomatoes, onions, rice, sugar cane, cactus$(br)$(bold)Autumn:$() wheat, pumpkins, beetroot, carrots, cabbage, rice$(br)$(bold)Winter:$() sweet berries, spruce

Year-round: mushrooms, nether wart, cave vines.$(br2)$(bold)Greenhouse Glass$() (Serene Seasons) makes any crop under it count as in-season. A glass roof over a farm is the winter plan. Below Y=48 fertility is ignored too — deep farms work all year.
